description: Multi-step reasoning questions requiring inference chains

questions.prompt: If laxity_score = 0.23 and context = :irap_protected (max 0.20), what severity does LaxityProbe return?
questions.reference_answer: critical severity because 0.23 exceeds the IRAP_PROTECTED threshold of 0.20

questions.prompt: Given UCB1 scores [0.8, 0.6, 0.9], which skill is selected next?
questions.reference_answer: The skill with UCB1 score 0.9 (index 2) is selected as it has the highest upper confidence bound

questions.prompt: A coalition of agents [A, B, C] changes to [A, B] — does SpeculumFreshness return :stale or :changed?
questions.reference_answer: SpeculumFreshness returns :changed because the coalition membership has been modified

questions.prompt: Stack has 21 open sorrys. sorry_depth = ceil(21/10) = ? Does it pass the SLO limit of 2?
questions.reference_answer: sorry_depth = ceil(21/10) = 3, which exceeds the SLO limit of 2 and therefore does not pass

questions.prompt: A TokenGov matter has conflicting obligations X and Y. What does ConflictDetector return?
questions.reference_answer: ConflictDetector returns a conflict report identifying the obligations X and Y as contradictory with a recommended resolution strategy

questions.prompt: If Elan DriftSensor detects KL-divergence 0.15 against threshold 0.10, what event type does MetaBus emit?
questions.reference_answer: MetaBus emits a :distribution_drift event because the KL-divergence of 0.15 exceeds the threshold of 0.10

questions.prompt: A skill DAG has 3 nodes, 2 with sorry_depth 1 and 1 clean. What is the overall laxity_score?
questions.reference_answer: laxity_score = 2/3 approximately 0.667 because 2 out of 3 nodes have non-zero sorry_depth
